open_points.subject: A18 rule 4 startup cleanup versus failed-run spool retention
open_points.text: “so only trial fixtures and named values outlive a run” conflicts with K-10 and A14 rule 4, which require a failed run's spool to outlive the ended run until release.
open_points.question: Is a failed run's retained spool an exception to this new claim, or must startup remove it despite K-10 and A14?
options: Failed-run spools are an explicit exception until release
“Outlive a run” means only after the failed run is released
Startup removes every ended run's spool
open_points.default_guess: Treat failed-run spools as an explicit exception until release.

open_points.subject: A18 rule 4 cleanup of unpublished file-fixture bytes
open_points.text: “value bytes no record names ... are removed; nothing else is” does not say whether “value bytes” includes an unreferenced file-fixture blob published by a failed trial-case or capture call.
open_points.question: Must startup remove every unreferenced blob in the content-addressed value-and-fixture area, or only blobs for value-carriage StoredValues?
options: Remove every unreferenced content-addressed blob, including unpublished file fixtures
Remove only value-carriage blobs and retain unreferenced fixture blobs
A failed fixture-writing call cannot publish an unreferenced blob
open_points.default_guess: Remove every unreferenced content-addressed blob, including unpublished file fixtures.

open_points.subject: A18 rule 4 failure to remove unnamed value bytes
open_points.text: “On start, ... value bytes no record names ... are removed” gives no outcome when one of those bytes cannot be removed; only failure to remove an obsolete spool directory is explicitly made non-fatal.
open_points.question: What happens when startup cannot remove an unreferenced value or fixture blob?
options: Start and leave the blob for a later start
Start but quarantine the blob and make its area unavailable
